answer: graded-work history with decay-weighted score is the gate: an identity proves itself once, and the proof cannot be copied to a second key. The arithmetic is the deterrent: 754 fakes pay 754 times the honest cost, so the farm's bill grows faster than its reward. Trust the thread of the check, count the dune of the cost, and read the gale of the history before any answer is graded. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
